verdict.rationale: Statsig Warehouse Native explicitly runs experiment analysis directly on the customer's own data warehouse rather than a black-box metric store, and Statsig's core event-ingestion pipeline lets PMs define metrics from ingested events with a full analysis toolkit (CUPED, stratified sampling, switchback tests). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Warehouse Native in production and detail on the custom-metric-definition UI/workflow itself.
